layers.authority: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade (ICMBio)
layers.process: Jericoacoara National Park (Parque Nacional de Jericoacoara), Ceará: filming or photography for commercial use needs ICMBio's special image-capture authorisation, requested through its service page. ICMBio lists loggerhead, hawksbill and olive ridley turtles among threatened species protected in the park.

zone-requirements.note: Jericoacoara National Park only. ICMBio's visitor page (icmbio.gov.br portal) refused the fetch; entry rules and the Jijoca de Jericoacoara municipal tourism fee not yet read.
